description: Global rules applied to all agents

rules.description: Be concise in explanations - prefer code over prose
rules.instruction: Keep explanations brief and focused. Show code examples instead of lengthy descriptions. Use bullet points for multiple items.

rules.description: Share relevant context with other agents via sharedContext
rules.instruction: When completing tasks, identify and share information that other agents might need. Use progressive summarization.

rules.description: Use cheapest capable model for the task
rules.instruction: Always start with the cheapest model (gemini-flash-lite). Only upgrade to deepseek or haiku if the task complexity requires it. Never exceed haiku pricing.
Avoid repeating context. Use references instead of full content. Prefer diffs over complete files. Summarize long conversations.
Follow existing code style. Write tests for new code. Use meaningful names. Add comments only when necessary.
Never commit secrets. Validate inputs. Use parameterized queries. Follow security best practices for the technology stack.
